name: @hanzc0106/swagger-mcp

tools.name: init_project
tools.description: Create .swagger-mcp/config.json and cache directory in the requested workspace.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List configured Swagger services and local cache state. This never fetches remote documents.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: add_service
tools.description: Add a named Swagger/OpenAPI source. It does not fetch the document.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

service.description: Stable service name, such as datapool.

url.description: Swagger/OpenAPI JSON URL or file URL.

tools.name: update_service
tools.description: Update a service URL. It does not fetch the document.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: remove_service
tools.description: Remove a service from config. Existing cached document is preserved.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: refresh_service
tools.description: Explicitly fetch one remote Swagger/OpenAPI JSON document and overwrite only its local cache.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: refresh_all_services
tools.description: Explicitly refresh every configured service. This is the only bulk network operation.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: search_operations
tools.description: Search operations only in the local cached document. It never fetches remote Swagger.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Read one cached operation by operationId, or by method and path.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Read and resolve one schema from a cached Swagger/OpenAPI document.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

tools.name: generate_request_example
tools.description: Generate curl, axios, or fetch code from one cached operation.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the business project that owns .swagger-mcp.

baseUrl.description: Optional API base URL. Falls back to spec server URL.

instructions: Swagger documents are queried only from local cache. Use refresh_service explicitly to fetch remote documents.
